standard_prerequisites.name: The subpresheaf of modules generated by a family of local sections, consisting of the finite sums of multiples of the sections over opens on which they are defined
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Constructed inside the counted proof at source lines 626-637
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the presheaf whose sheafification will be the required subsheaf.

standard_prerequisites.name: The criterion that the sheafification of a subpresheaf of a sheaf of modules is again a subsheaf
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof at source lines 638-640) as a cross-chapter pointer
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows that the sheafification produced by the proof is a subsheaf of the given sheaf.

core_obligations: Write down the generated presheaf: the proof defines, on each open, the set of finite sums of multiples of the restrictions of the given local sections, and observes that this is a subpresheaf of modules of the given sheaf (proof lines 626-637)
Sheafify: the sheafification of that subpresheaf is again a subsheaf of the given sheaf, by the cross-chapter criterion (proof lines 638-640)
Minimality: every subsheaf containing the given local sections must contain all those finite sums, so the constructed subsheaf is the smallest one (proof lines 641-642)
proof_roadmap: 定义子预层 U ↦ { ∑_{i∈J} f_i (s_i|_U) : J 有限, U ⊂ U_i (i∈J), f_i ∈ O_X(U) }，它是 F 的模子预层。
取其层化 G；由跨章判据 G 仍是 F 的子层；任何含全部 s_i 的子层必含所有这些有限和，故 G 是最小者。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement constructs the smallest subsheaf of modules containing a given family of local sections (author lemma at source lines 613-623, label lemma-generated-by-local-sections). The proof (source lines 625-643) writes down the subpresheaf of finite sums of multiples of the sections, sheafifies it, verifies that the result is a subsheaf by a cross-chapter criterion, and observes that every subsheaf containing the sections must contain those sums (proof lines 626-642). The explicit description by finite sums is the content. H2.
